requirement.text: The product shall allow a user to remove himself or herself from the list of players at any time.

initial_eus.title: Self-Removal from Player List
initial_eus.description: As a player, I want to remove myself from the list of players at any time, so that my participation continues only for as long as I choose.
work_items: The product shall allow a user to remove himself or herself from the list of players.
Self-removal from the list of players shall be available at any time.

analysis.ethical_objective: Respect user autonomy by ensuring users retain control over their participation and can withdraw from the list of players whenever they choose.

obligations.text: The product shall allow a user to remove himself or herself from the list of players.
obligations.source_span: The product shall allow a user to remove himself or herself from the list of players

obligations.text: Self-removal from the list of players shall be available at any time, without restriction to particular moments or conditions.

constraints: Removal must be initiated by the user for himself or herself (self-removal), not by another party on the user's behalf.
The capability applies to the list of players specifically.
The capability must not be limited to specific times, phases, or conditions ('at any time').
ambiguities: The source does not define what the 'list of players' is or what participation in it entails.
The source does not specify the consequences of removal (e.g., effects on ongoing games, data retention, or ability to rejoin).
The source does not specify whether removal is immediate or whether any confirmation is involved.
The source does not clarify whether 'user' is limited to those currently on the list of players.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume removal implies deletion of the user's account or personal data.
Do not assume any confirmation, cooling-off, or undo process.
Do not assume a specific UI mechanism (e.g., a button or settings page) for removal.
Do not assume constraints on how often removal may occur or whether the user may re-add himself or herself.
Do not assume removal must be irreversible or reversible.
Do not assume notification of other players or administrators upon removal.
possible_operational_aspects: The removal capability must be accessible to the user at any time.
The removal action is performed by the user for himself or herself.

work_items.explanation: Restates the core capability that a user may remove himself or herself from the list of players, matching O1's explicit self-removal obligation.
Expresses the 'at any time' availability condition on self-removal, corresponding to O2's requirement that removal not be restricted to particular moments or conditions.
